english.title: Unauthorised supply of gas through pipes
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) supplied gas

(A)_[to the value of **(..SPECIFY VALUE..)]_
(B)_[of a value unknown]_

through pipes to premises at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..) without being authorised to do so by a licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(b) and (3) of the Gas Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
supplied gas
through pipes to premises
not authorised by licence

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 5(2) and 6A for exceptions.
(ii) No proceedings shall be instituted except by or on behalf of the Secretary of State or the Director General of Gas Supply (section 5(4)).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: a fine.
Time limit for prosecutions:None
For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
